relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Dual treatment with the NK1 receptor antagonist aprepitant and the CGRP receptor antagonist olcegepant reduced pain sensitivity in either neuropathic pain model or naive mice.

relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Co-administration of aprepitant and olcegepant more significantly alleviated pain behaviors than administration of single agents or vehicle, increasing the mechanical threshold and improving the response latency.

relationships.subject: Olcegepant
relationships.evidence_quote: Dual pharmacological treatment with aprepitant and olcegepant had more significant anxiolytic effects in both neuropathic pain model and naive mice than treatment with a single agent, as evaluated by the EPM test.

key_findings: Co-administration of aprepitant (NK1 antagonist) and olcegepant (CGRP antagonist) alleviated neuropathic and formalin pain more than either alone, with an additive isobologram effect.
Dual treatment also reduced pain-associated anxiety-like behavior in the elevated plus maze.
